#!/bin/sh
# realmcradle-managed ARK Ascended server — generated by provision().
. <ROOT>/secrets.conf
mkdir -p "<ROOT>/installs/asa/cluster"
export WINEPREFIX="<ROOT>/home/.wine-rc-asa-test"
export WINEDEBUG=-all
export WINEDLLOVERRIDES="mscoree,mshtml="   # no Mono/Gecko install prompts (headless)
# Run headless: Wine would otherwise open a console window on the desktop
# session (unsetting DISPLAY alone isn't enough — it falls back to Wayland).
unset DISPLAY
export WAYLAND_DISPLAY=wayland-none
cd "<ROOT>/installs/asa/ShooterGame/Binaries/Win64" || exit 1
exec wine ./ArkAscendedServer.exe \
    "TheIsland_WP?listen?SessionName=Test World?Port=7800?RCONEnabled=True?RCONPort=27045?AltSaveDirectoryName=rc_test?ServerPVE=True?ServerPassword=${GAME_SERVER_PASSWORD}?ServerAdminPassword=${GAME_ADMIN_PASSWORD}" \
    -port=7800 -WinLiveMaxPlayers=10 -NoBattlEye -server -log \
    -clusterid=realmcradle -ClusterDirOverride="Z:<WINROOT>\\installs\\asa\\cluster" -ServerPlatform=PC
files.installs/asa/realmcradle-test-stop.sh:
#!/bin/sh
# realmcradle-managed graceful stop: ask the server to save and quit, then wait.
. <ROOT>/secrets.conf
"<PYTHON>" - 27045 "$GAME_ADMIN_PASSWORD" <<'STOP'
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '<APP>')
import monitor
for cmd in ['SaveWorld', 'DoExit']:
    monitor.source_rcon(int(sys.argv[1]), sys.argv[2], cmd, timeout=15)
STOP
i=0
while [ $i -lt 115 ] && pgrep -f -- 'AltSaveDirectoryName=rc_test\?' >/dev/null; do sleep 1; i=$((i+1)); done
WINEPREFIX="<ROOT>/home/.wine-rc-asa-test" wineserver -k 2>/dev/null
exit 0
